profile.headline: Sr. Cloud Software Engineer @ Abbott | M.S. Computer Science (UIUC) | B.S. Electrical Engineering (Michigan State)
profile.summary:
As a Cloud Software Engineer at Abbott, I have been working on Django, React, and Jenkins to implement automated deployment of Cloud services within an internal Self-Service platform. I have also held roles as a Data Engineer, Cloud Security Specialist, and DevOps Engineer within Abbott's IT Professional Development Program.

I am a passionate and driven software engineer with a strong background in cloud computing and full-stack development. My experience in developing and deploying cloud-based solutions has enabled me to develop a deep understanding of cloud architecture and infrastructure. I have a proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions that meet business requirements and exceed customer expectations.

Skills: Cloud Computing, Generative AI, Data Engineering, Full-Stack Development, Django, React, Jenkins, DevOps, Cloud Architecture, Infrastructure, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Technical Communication

positions.title: Cloud Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Terraform · Gitlab · Docker · Jenkins · Cloud Applications · Django REST Framework · React.js · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SQL · Cloud Computing · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Data Engineer (IT Professional Development Program Final Rotation)
positions.description:
- Developed the ETL pipelines within Azure Data Factory resulting in successful integration of CosmosDB, SQL, and B2C into Azure Synapse, enabling teams to run regular data processing jobs and create business management reports
- Served as the technical subject matter expert in HL7 and developed the HL7 Python Class that generates proper HL7 messages from NAVICA tests that are transmitted to State Public Health Agencies
- Implemented Azure Purview into NAVICA as a POC to tackle information management pain points that key stakeholders face within the ecosystem

positions.title: Cloud Cybersecurity Specialist (IT Professional Development Program 2nd Rotation)
positions.description:
- Lead development of Python scripts to interact with Prisma Cloud API enabling the capabilities for the Cloud Governance to automate operations
- Developed the algorithm to process csv files for alert dismissal requests in Prisma realizing in a 2000%-time reduction compared to manual dismissals
- Collaborated with Enterprise Cybersecurity team to develop external IP scanning of AWS and Azure services allowing for visibility and reduction of public facing resources in the cloud
- Migrated policies and standards from US Prisma Cloud platform into China's platform allowing for Abbott Cloud accounts and owners to have better compliance

positions.title: DevSecOps Engineer (IT Professional Development Program 1st Rotation)
positions.description:
- Leveraged Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for creation of   modules for deployment of Azure resources within a hybrid cloud architecture (Hub-Spoke Topology)
- Automated solutions for consistent builds of Azure environments allowing for business unit applications to be secured and privatized
- Worked with DevOps team to develop a Spoke module in Terraform reducing the consumer’s frontend code from 300+ lines to approximately 20
- Implemented CI/CD testing in Gitlab with Chef Inspec to automate tests between the Terraform deployment and Azure’s API

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
- Collaborated with Electrical, Mechanical and Biomedical team to lead the research and
development of the exoskeleton suit in all three areas
- Raised over $4000 for the team through presentations to sponsors demonstrating the
suit’s capabilities in the fall semester
- Developed the business sector of the team with the President for future progress of the
growing team

positions.title: Automation Intern
positions.description:
- Conducted testing of smart instrumentation and control systems for future
implementation at all manufacturing plants
- Designed HART instrumentation layout to stream data into analog input cards for data
analysis to determine device capabilities
- Determined a 75%-time reduction in transmitter configuration through comparison of
manual to autonomous device setup
- Collaborated with plant engineers to determine benefits of application, including
$200,000 in savings for device commissioning

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Designed software for manual and autonomous navigation of a mobility base in surgical
setting using C++ and Python
- Programmed TCP sockets for serial communication and transferring data between
devices
- Interpreted LIDAR sensor data and integrated data into RViz for visualization of
surroundings and obstacle avoidance
- Streamed and analyzed USB data from SpaceMouse to allow for joystick control of
mobility base
- Optimized base code for more efficient speed and acceleration calculations, realizing a
10% decrease in calculation time

positions.title: MSU CoRe Tutor
positions.description: Tutor of Physics 2 (PHY184) at Michigan State.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Participated in a Biomedical Engineering graduate research project on animal behavioral studies researching solutions used in practices today to design a cost-effective platform.  Built an Arduino-based platform consisting of a microcontroller, LED stimulators, and levers from scratch.

volunteerExperiences.role: Data Entry Screener for COVID Vaccinations
volunteerExperiences.description:
- Recorded background and required data into the Lake County Health Department's patient management system for incoming patients receiving their COVID vaccinations.
- Maintained organization of work area to ensure patients are receiving the correct brand and dose of the COVID vaccine.
